test.name: A hand-off the agent closed without a capture is still listed as handed_to_user under the hand-off's own log id
test.description: recent-birth-handoff-agent-closed is recent-birth-sealed plus a Newspapers.com birth-announcement search handed to the researcher (log_008, partial, no capture) and later closed by the agent itself (log_009, negative, same url_generated, no capture, 'requires a paid subscription'). project_context.awaitingUser drops it because log_009 closes the row. The agent must build not_reached from the research log and list the hand-off as handed_to_user with log_entry_id log_008. Guards issue #2539's 2026-10-16 ruling and the Saarland harm in issue #3416, where the user was told a record was unreachable and never given the link back.

input.delegation:
Assess whether question q_001 is reasonably exhaustive and record the outcome — declaring if the criteria are met, and declining without a write if they are not.

questionId: q_001
projectPath: <workspace>

judge_context: The parents are established exactly as in recent-birth-sealed: the 1940 and 1950 censuses and the 1926 Weber County marriage, with church and probate searched nil and the 1936 birth certificate privacy-sealed. On this evidence the agent SHOULD declare q_001 (a stop-gate stopped_because) and write search_stop.

log_008 handed the researcher a Newspapers.com search for a 1936 birth announcement; no capture came back. log_009 is a later entry for the SAME url_generated that the agent wrote itself, outcome negative, still no capture. A later entry without a capture does not close a hand-off.

REQUIRED: search_stop.not_reached contains a handed_to_user entry whose log_entry_id is log_008 (the hand-off), not log_009 (the closer), with wiki_title null and a description naming Newspapers.com, the search URL and what it was for (Alan's birth announcement / his parents).

FAILURE MODES: (a) no handed_to_user entry for the newspaper search; (b) the entry cites log_009; (c) the newspaper search is recorded as a nil_search or as searched-and-negative, as though the record was examined; (d) the hand-off is listed as paywalled instead of handed_to_user — it WAS handed to the user; (e) refusing to declare solely because the newspaper capture never came back, since a birth announcement is corroborative here, not decisive.
The sealed birth certificate may also appear in not_reached as privacy_sealed; that is correct and not a failure.
Tool Arguments: grade the research_append update on q_001 and the research_query reads (section log with questionId; section localities).
